provenance: Human remains the isolated I2 implementation default because v25 does not serialize an exact starter-race list. Mantle and Chronicle intentionally begin unavailable: they are later Tavern progression systems and are never Campaign Door prerequisites. I15 adds six free starter Tavern Adventurers (2 support, 2 tank, 2 damage) and leaves the remaining seven to easy Forest accomplishments. I18 adds the one-time mandatory starter onboarding reward and isolated tutorial/help state; it does not auto-unlock Kept Impressions.
